verdict.rationale: Event subscriptions via webhooks are a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. However, the pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP webhook callbacks. The closest item (elastic-docs-22) only says alerts can send notifications 'via services or third-party incident management systems', which is an adjacent alerting feature and not a documented webhook that a programmatic consumer can register and receive.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
